# June 2026 ad-spend reports

Two exports exist for June: june-report-final.csv is the finance-confirmed statement issued on June 30; june-report-superseded.csv is the pre-adjustment draft kept for archive only and its numbers were later revised.

turns.prompt: I need the June ad-spend figures from the reporting folder.
The finance-confirmed one. What was the total spend across all channels in June? Answer with the number alone, two decimals.
And how much of that total was search ads? Answer with the number alone, two decimals.
